title: The Ten Hymns of Synesius
author: Synesius of Cyrene (Stevenson trans)
description: The hymns of Synesius of Cyrene bring philosophical and devotional language together in late antique religious poetry. They explore the soul's relationship with the divine through a vocabulary shaped by Neoplatonism and Christianity.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/tenhymnsofsynesi00stev).
